pages.name: Philidor Defense: Lopez Countergambit
pages.notes: Plan 2 put White's 4.exf5 in Black's plan and called the f-file open (half-open for Black); plan 4's ...g5 'towards the white king' replaced with ...Nf6/...e4 and f-file play. British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Philidor: Improved Hanham, 5.Bc4
pages.notes: Plan 4 had both sides' moves (exd4, Nxd4) in Black's plan; plan 3 listed an ...e5 break when the pawn is already on e5. Rewrote both. British spelling in the overview and plans 1 and 2.

pages.name: Philidor: Improved Hanham, 6.dxe5
pages.notes: Plan 2 routed the knight ...Nf8-e6 from a square it isn't on; plan 1 had f4 behind the f3-knight. The overview now explains the recaptures and the Bxf7+/Ng5+ tricks after 6...dxe5 (a first version called the d-file open after either recapture and was rejected). British spelling in plan 3.

pages.name: Philidor: Improved Hanham, 6.dxe5 Nxe5
pages.notes: The overview had knights already exchanged; plan 1 had Qxd8+ through the d6-pawn and c2-c4 onto the c4-bishop; plan 2 solidified an e5-pawn that is a knight; plan 3 called the c1-bishop light-squared; plan 4 rerouted the knight from d7, where it no longer is. Rewrote all.

pages.name: Philidor: Improved Hanham, 7.a4
pages.notes: Plan 2 had the knight via f8 with the rook on f8; plan 1 had Re1-e3-g3 through the f3-knight; plan 4's ...h6 and ...g5 replaced by ...exd4, ...Re8, ...Bf8. British spelling in the overview and plan 3.

pages.name: Philidor: Improved Hanham, 7.a4 c6
pages.notes: Plan 3 had the knight via f8 with the rook on f8; plan 2's ...exd4 then ...c5 (with the pawn on c6) replaced by ...a5, ...Qc7, ...exd4, ...Re8 and ...Bf8. British spelling in the overview and plan 1.

pages.name: Philidor: Improved Hanham, 7.Qe2 c6 8.a4
pages.notes: Plan 4 had Bd3 (read as d3, and blocked by nothing but pointless); now Ba2 or Bb3. Plan 1 had f2-f4 behind the f3-knight; plan 3 ...b5 against the a4-pawn. Rewrote those. British spelling in the overview and plan 2.

pages.name: Philidor: Improved Hanham, 7.Re1 c6 8.a4
pages.notes: Plan 2 rerouted a 'b7-knight' (it is on d7) to f8 with the rook there; fixed. British spelling in the overview and plan 1.

pages.name: Philidor: Improved Hanham, 7.Re1 c6 8.a4 a5
pages.notes: Plan 3 had Bd3; now Ba2 or Bb3. Plan 2 rerouted a 'b8-knight' via c7 (it is on d7); rewrote it. British spelling in the overview and plans 1 and 4.

pages.name: Philidor: Improved Hanham, 7.Re1 c6 8.a4 b6
pages.notes: Plan 4 rerouted the 'b8-knight' via d7-f8 (it is on d7, the rook is on f8); now ...Re8 first. The overview's 'Hedgehog' label dropped. British spelling in plans 1 and 2.
